text_excerpts.2:
How to enjoy your Zozobra experience:
   Arrive at your departing station at least 10 minutes early
   From the train: Exit at the South Capitol Station
and take the FREE shuttle to the event. 
   Afterwards: Take the shuttle back to the South Capitol Station. 
                         Trains will not be departing from the Santa Fe Depot.
• Are backpacks allowed? No purses or backpacks allowed. Clear bags only. Childcare and 
medical supplies must be in a clear plastic bag, NFL stadium-style.
• Are food and drinks allowed in the venue?  Yes. All picnic food must be in a clear plastic 
bag, NFL stadium-style. No coolers, glass containers or disposable plastic bottles. No liquids in 
containers of any kind; water and drinks can be purchased on-site. Outside food must be 
transferred into clear food-grade bags provided at the Zozobra food stations. 
• Is food available? There are over 20 different food vendors on-site. Bottled water, sodas, and 
sweet treats will be available.
• Are pets allowed? No, only uniformed service animals.
• Are lawn chairs allowed? No metal lawn chairs; collapsible umbrella-style lawn chairs are 
allowed in the General Admission area only. No chairs, camera tripods, or large equipment are 
allowed in the Premium Viewing areas due to safety restrictions.
• Are strollers or wagons allowed? No strollers or wagons of any kind are allowed in the 
venue. If you bring them, you will need to check them in for safe storage at the Bike Valet in the 
Montezuma Lodge parking lot.
Customer Service Hrs: Mon. - Wed. 6am - 10:00pm | Thr. - Fri. 6am - 11:30pm
Sat. 7:30am - 11:30pm |  Sun. 7am - 10pm 
For more information: 505.245.7245 | www.riometro.org/zozobra
Important: All guests and passengers must go through
multiple security checks at both the South Capitol Station and the venue.
Lorem 
It’s the 102nd Anniversary
Burning of ZOZOBRA
Santa Fe, NM
Friday, September 4, 2026
No worries...
Ride the NM Rail Runner Express
and take the free shuttle to Fort Marc
